# Resource Explorer resource type strings and the CloudFormation type each should map to.
#
# Format: <resource explorer type> <cloudformation type | ->
# "-" means the type has no Cloud Control (CloudFormation registry) equivalent, so the scanner
# reports it once as an unsupported_type notice and skips its resources.
#
# Source: the "Resource types you can search for with Resource Explorer" table of the AWS
# Resource Explorer User Guide (the same list `aws resource-explorer-2
# list-supported-resource-types` returns), transcribed by hand as a subset covering the
# commonly scanned services, Oct 2026. It is not the full list. To refresh it, run
#
#   aws resource-explorer-2 list-supported-resource-types \
#     --query 'ResourceTypes[].ResourceType' --output text | tr '\t' '\n'
#
# and give each new line its CloudFormation type, or "-". TestExplorerTypeFixture logs every
# type that does not map, so new gaps are visible.
